prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1431; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision described in your file, which occurred in a side impact at an intersection. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including any contact with our client, to this office. Our client is not to be contacted directly by you, your insured, or any agent acting on your behalf.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits of all policies that may apply to the insured driver and vehicle involved in this collision, including any excess or umbrella coverage, together with a certified copy of the declarations page for each policy.

We further demand that you preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, dash camera and telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, recorded statements, claim notes, adjuster reports, and any repair or salvage records for both vehicles. Please ensure that this material is not altered, discarded, or repaired without prior written notice to this office.

Please confirm receipt of this letter and your agreement to these requests in writing within fourteen days.
